TC-22/S23.title: Browser clock a day off: a task closed by Save & Extract is stamped with server time
TC-22/S23.detail: Local stack 8b4be94a (round-companion-wt-qa), under runs/.local-stack.lock and the AI tripwire ('no model call'); every ai/* action answered at the Convex socket. rb1-ext-tc22-s23-clock.spec.ts: browser clock +24 h and −24 h, both modes: doneAt within 0 min of server time (the client no longer stamps doneAt; convex/lib/taskStamps.ts), and the Hospital task stays under Finished Tasks after the lifecycle run. On 43c38a4f doneAt followed the device clock and the −24 h task was cleaned away. This fixes the task-done-time part of B18 only.
